title: Eigenvalues of one family of tridiagonal skew-self-adjoint Toeplitz matrices with complex perturbations on the corner
summary: In this paper, we study the eigenvalues of the matrices $T_n(a)+γE_{n,1,1}$ where $T_n(a)$ is the Toeplitz matrix with generating symbol $a(t)=t-t^{-1}$, $E_{n,1,1}$ is the $n\times n$ matrix whose upper left component is $1$ and the other components are zero, and $γ$ is a fixed complex number such that $0<|γ|<1$. As $n\to\infty$, the eigenvalues of these matrices are asymptotically distributed as the function $2 i \sin(x)$, $x\in[0,2π]$. Our main result is an asymptotic formula for every eigenvalue with a residue of the order $O(1/n^3)$.
